Which numbers are real

Real, from the workbooks and the API:
1,592 trained · Grow 793 (Accra 402, Whizzy 236, Woman's Haven 155) · Pre-Mest 761/759/758/757 · Web3 26+12=38 · MEST Scale 101 of 112 · EdTech 2026: 38 posts, 2,800,672 impressions, 1,978,763 reach, 7,920 engagement, 230,786 video views.

Illustrative, to show the form:
the month-by-month split of the EdTech totals (it sums to the real 2,800,672), the channel shares, the deltas and targets, and every name in the approvals queue.

Nothing here invents a headline figure MEST does not have.

Reading order

1 · Overview — what the whole organisation reports
2 · Programme page — the four-part rhythm every programme gets: Change, Composition, Every metric at once, Provenance
3 · Chart vocabulary — the eleven forms and the job each one does
4 · Provenance drawer — click any number, anywhere
5 · Approvals + Import centre — who may change data, and how a workbook gets in
6 · Type & colour — the foundations everything above is built from
